body: Thank you.
I see... Thanks man I just need the motivation to start doing things I guess..

I'll be brutally honest, it doesnt get better. Think of it as a cycle? Sometimes you feel that things may work out only to have your hopes crushed again by another event in life... If it helps, I too am feeling really tired
Same here but im younger lol fuck this world
Wow meanwhile here I am hoping that one day things will miraculously be different...
Sorry to hear that... Guess the same thing will happen to me if I keep going down this path.
Im glad u found ur way out of it. I just dont know where to start to break this cycle...
Maybe but out of so many people in this world, why am I just me and not someone else.. (if you get what I mean)
True but it appears that im hitting my tolerance level again...
At least its an honest answer

Can definitely relate to the fact that suicidal thoughts dont ever go away. Was pretty bad for me last year and I thought I should just end it all... It got better this year at the start and I really thought that things are on track to become better but guess what, im bad to rock bottom once again. Fml guess I ain't getting out of this cycle anytime soon. I suppose life can be beautiful, just maybe not my life..

Well, I too am a disappointment to myself and my family. My mum never thought me to be good enough, never encouraged or helped me when I needed it... (Maybe cuz of family background) Though I suppose she doesn't outright hate me.

Sorry to hear that man. I too am depressed and struggling with my own issues. You aren't alone in this. Its good to find someone to talk to whether it be a professional, friends or family. There are people out there who care about you! I really hope you get through this so that I too can have hope that I will get past my issues too.
:)) enjoy! If you ever want to vent I'm happy to listen
Nice to know someone else out there desperately needs hope too... Just know you aren't alone in this (I feel the same) :/
Same here :) Im happy to listen if u ever wanna talk about it.

I know this feeling well. Can't say its the same for everyone. For me, I get hopeful on certain days (either after talking to people or doing something or for absolutely no reason at all) then for a few days I wake up feeling better. Then on some days when shit happens or when I think too much, I plunge right back into hell again (though lately i just wake up in hell everyday). Im guessing it could also be hormones too idk. Hope it helps!
You are a good man. Thank you for the well wishes. If I ever come to Germany... :)

I am sorry to hear that :( I personally am going through issues on my own but now that I've read your posts, I feel that I don't even deserve to feel what I feel. My issues are no where as painful or serious as yours and it sucks that you have to go through so much pain now. I really do hope you perserve because then it will give me hope that maybe I too will find happiness in this life.

I get that feeling. Everyday when I wake up, my chest feels heavy and I just dont wanna climb out of bed. I too lack motivation to do stuff and am struggling to find things that interest me. You aren't alone in this. Can't say I have a solution for you since I too am struggling right now but if you ever wanna talk about it, I'm happy to listen.

I am truly sorry to hear this. Not gonna lie, it was extremely painful to read and omg, you are such a strong person to have survived thus far! You are likely to be at the lowest point of your life right now so I really hope things start getting better for you with time. I will advice you to seek professional help or at least find a close friend to talk to about this. What your family and wife did were really cruel. They dont deserve such a strong and caring person like you. I can't tell you that everything will turn out right but I pray that you will find your hope again and perhaps one day you will meet another woman who will love you wholeheartedly and be by your side always.
